title: OmniAssistBench: Assistant-style Interaction Benchmark for Omni-LLMs
authors: Xianyun Sun, Chaoyou Fu, Zhengye Zhang et al.
abstract: Recent omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) show great potential as real-time video assistants, which continuously perceive environments and guide users to achieve specific goals. Unlike traditional passive video understanding, interactive assistants should actively combine visual states, user goals, and prior knowledge to provide effective help.
